caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or rug with a border of dark color, possibly black, surrounding the entire piece. Inside the border, the composition is divided horizontally into two rows. Each row features six heart-shaped objects, totaling twelve hearts. The hearts are large, red in color, and are rendered with visible texture or concentric patterns inside some of them, giving a sense of depth and layering. Some of the hearts show visible wear, with areas of white patches indicating damage or loss of material. The background behind the hearts is divided into two sections: the upper and lower sections are filled with a textured blue color, while the middle horizontal strip behind the hearts is green, creating a contrast with the red of the hearts. The overall arrangement is symmetrical, with the hearts evenly spaced, and the entire piece is presented on a neutral, off-white background. The name "James Hall" is written in small text in the lower right corner outside of the rectangular composition.
title: Hooked Rug
